objective: Agregar observabilidad sanitizada al modo SQL_MIGRATION_DEVELOPMENT para distinguir fallos de contrato/credenciales de fallos del runner SQL sin publicar stdout crudo ni secretos. Limitar el cambio al dispatcher y a su test de contrato. operation_summary solo puede publicar returncode, status, credential_source dedicado/canonical y error_code de MigrationContractError con formato seguro. No tocar SQL, .env, core ni Production.

actions.old:
assert 'sql_migration_failed:rc=' in block
    assert 'check_failed:sql_migration_post_audit' in block
actions.new:
assert 'sql_migration_failed:rc=' in block
    assert 'safe_migration_summary' in block
    assert 'result["operation_summary"] = safe_migration_summary' in block
    assert 'MigrationContractError:' in block
    assert 'credential_source' in block
    assert 'check_failed:sql_migration_post_audit' in block
